fields.summary_ko.0: Texas Instruments (TXN) surged +89.2% over 5 years, significantly outpacing NXP Semiconductors (NXPI) at +34.5%, with the key driver being the difference in earnings multiples paid by investors rather than revenue growth.
fields.summary_ko.1: NXP's P/E declined from 33.1x in 2021 to current 20.9x, while Texas Instruments has risen from 24.2x, and NXP's EPS increased +124.7% while TXN declined -1.0%.
